package.name: mid360_car3
package.description: Standalone car3 mecanum wheel car with a Livox MID-360 3D LiDAR replacing the 2D hokuyo. Reuses the car3_control chassis (mecanum / ros_control / ground-truth odom) and the livox_laser_simulation gazebo plugin (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 on /scan). lidar:=mid360 switches car3.xacro to the MID-360 sensor; red_marker keeps the intruder variant (red cube) / pursuit-car variant (no cube) split.
